verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a task and workflow orchestration platform with a dashboard and TUI, so in-product AI insights (for example, AI analysis of failed runs or suggestions from run data) is a fair axis. The evidence shows only observability features and cookbooks for building your own agents, such as the support-agent example and exposing workflows as agent tools. None of it shows built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data.
